crossRefs.note: God listened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.
She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “This time I will praise Yahweh.” Therefore she named him Judah. Then…
She gave him Bilhah her servant as wife, and Jacob went in to her.
Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Leah
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of six sons and Dinah

people.name: Zilpah
people.line: Leah's maidservant; mother of Gad and Asher

translations.web: When Leah saw that she had finished bearing, she took Zilpah, her servant, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.
translations.bsb: When Leah saw that she had stopped having children, she gave her servant Zilpah to Jacob as a wife.
translations.kjv: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.
translations.asv: When Leah saw that she had left off bearing, she took Zilpah her handmaid, and gave her to Jacob to wife.
